issues.description: The problem specification and UML require calculateRemainingOrderNumber() to return an int (the number of remaining orders). The provided solution implementation defines calculateRemainingOrderNumber() as void and prints order numbers instead of returning the integer. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected method signature and return value and will prevent them from following the specification/tests that expect an int result.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the implementation match the specification: change the method signature to 'public int calculateRemainingOrderNumber()' and return the number of remaining orders (e.g., return this.orders.length). Remove or separate any printing behavior so printing is not relied upon for returning the numeric result. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to specify a void method if returning an int was not intended.
